svg.aria-label: Sequence of one round of a fragment, in five phases. Train: nodes A, B and C train from the anchor, version 3. Publish: A and C put their delta, anchor minus parameters, in the mailbox. Collect: the syncer elected for this round runs on node C; it lists and gets the deltas and checks their versions, reaches the quorum of two, and opens a grace window, inside which B's delta arrives and is fetched. Merge and commit: the syncer merges the deltas with RDA, applies the Nesterov outer step, puts version 4 with its outer state, and commits the round by creating its record once. Align: each node polls, gets version 4 and aligns with it between its steps, A first, then C, then B.
svg.text: Every node runs a learner and a syncer; the syncer elected for this round runs on node C, its work in petrol on C's lifeline.
Arrows are requests to the mailbox, in the color of what sends them; replies are not drawn.
